learning_outcomes.text: Learn about soil types and specific resistance, and the measurement of soil specific resistance and propagation resistance.
Learn about network types and earthing resistance calculation methods.
Learn about earthing resistance calculation methods.
Learn about lightning rods and protection methods.
Learn about MV and LV surge arresters.

syllabus_topics: Importance, Types and Principles of Earthing
Measurement of Soil Specific Resistance and Spreading Resistance
Earthing Resistance Calculation Methods (Laurent, Koch and Schwarz)
Earthing System Design and Cross-Section Selection
Earthing of Dams and Power Plants, Transformer and Switchgear Centers, Energy Transmission Poles
Importance of Earthing in Occupational Health and Safety
assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are not specified in the 14-week course schedule. Midterm and final exam dates are determined by the decision of the University Senate in the academic calendar.
